verdict.rationale: WorkOS is an authentication platform, so session visibility and revocation is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents listing a user's active sessions or devices, or revoking them one at a time or all at once. The SDK mentions of "session management" and "sessions" helpers describe sign-in and token-refresh handling in the integrating app, which is adjacent rather than this capability.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can let users and admins see active sessions and devices and revoke them individually or all at once
